label: Saudi national ID / Iqama
validation: 10 digits; first digit 1 (citizen) or 2 (resident, Iqama); Luhn check digit
notes: SAMA documents the 10-digit structure (first digit 1 = citizen, 2 = resident; last digit is a verification digit) but not the formula. The Luhn rule used here is the widely used community rule (see the validator linked). About 1 in 10 random 10-digit numbers starting with 1 or 2 also pass, including some Unix timestamps; turn this type off for logs full of epoch times.
